question: How do I register a new account on the platform?
answer: To create a new account, click the 'Sign Up' button in the upper-right corner of the website. You can sign up using your corporate Google/Microsoft account or by entering your work email address and creating a strong password. A verification link will be sent to your inbox to activate your profile.

question: How can I reset my forgotten password?
answer: On the login screen, click 'Forgot Password?'. Enter your registered email address, and we will send a password reset token valid for 30 minutes. Follow the email link to choose a new password with at least 8 characters including letters, numbers, and symbols.

question: How do I configure Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?
answer: Go to User Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Click 'Enable 2FA', scan the barcode using an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or 1Password), and enter the 6-digit confirmation code to secure your login.

question: Why is my account locked and how do I unlock it?
answer: For security, accounts are temporarily locked for 30 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts. You can wait for the cooldown timer or click 'Unlock Account' in the security alert email sent to your inbox.

question: Can I link my account to Google or GitHub SSO?
answer: Yes. Navigate to Settings > Connected Accounts. You can link your Google, GitHub, or Apple ID to enable one-click Single Sign-On (SSO) for faster and safer logins.

question: How do I update my primary email address or username?
answer: Visit Account Settings > Profile Info. Enter your updated email or display name and confirm with your current password. A confirmation email will be sent to the new address to finalize verification.

question: What subscription plans are available?
answer: We offer Starter ($9/month per user), Professional ($29/month per user with AI features and priority support), and Enterprise (custom pricing with dedicated account manager, SLA, and custom vector limits).

question: How do I upgrade or downgrade my existing plan?
answer: Go to Billing > Plans & Usage. Select 'Upgrade' or 'Downgrade' on your desired tier. Upgrades apply immediately with prorated billing. Downgrades take effect at the conclusion of your current billing cycle.

question: Where can I download my monthly tax invoices and receipts?
answer: You can view and download all past VAT/GST-compliant PDF invoices under Settings > Billing > Invoices. Each record includes billing dates, itemized breakdowns, and transaction IDs.

question: How do I cancel my active subscription?
answer: Go to Billing > Subscription Management and click 'Cancel Subscription'. Follow the cancellation survey. You will maintain access to all paid features until the expiration of your prepaid period.

question: Do you offer annual discounts or education pricing?
answer: Yes! Annual billing plans include an automatic 20% discount. We also offer a 50% discount for accredited educational institutions, non-profit organizations, and student developers.

question: What happens when my free trial period ends?
answer: At the end of your 14-day free trial, your workspace will transition to the Free Tier unless you select a paid plan. Your data, projects, and settings will remain completely intact and safe.

question: What payment methods and currencies do you support?
answer: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and SEPA/ACH direct bank transfers. We support over 25 major currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, and INR.

question: How do I update or replace my credit card details?
answer: Navigate to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods. Click 'Add Card' or 'Edit' to update your card number, expiration date, and billing address.

question: What should I do if my payment fails during checkout?
answer: First verify that your card has international transactions enabled and sufficient funds. If the issue persists, contact your bank or try an alternative payment method like PayPal.

question: Is local sales tax or VAT included in the prices?
answer: Displayed prices are net of local sales taxes. Applicable taxes (VAT, GST, or state sales tax) are calculated and shown at checkout based on your country and billing address.

question: Can I get an invoice billed directly to my company entity?
answer: Yes. In your Billing settings, fill out the 'Company Legal Name' and 'Tax / VAT Identification Number' fields. These details will be automatically included on all future invoices.

question: What is the standard refund policy?
answer: We offer an unconditional 30-day money-back guarantee for all new software subscriptions and licenses. If you are not satisfied, contact support within 30 days of purchase for a full refund.

question: How long does it take for a refund to process?
answer: Once approved, our system submits the refund immediately. Banks and credit card issuers typically take 3 to 7 business days to credit the balance to your account.

question: Can I request a refund for unused API credits or consumed tokens?
answer: Unused pre-purchased API credit bundles can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Once credits or tokens are consumed for queries, they are non-refundable.

question: What if I was charged after forgetting to cancel auto-renewal?
answer: If you are charged for an unwanted auto-renewal, contact support within 7 business days of the charge without utilizing workspace features, and we will issue a full courtesy refund.

question: How do I return a defective physical hardware device?
answer: Submit a return request in the Hardware Portal with your serial number and photos of the defect. We will issue a prepaid return shipping label and ship a replacement within 24 hours.

question: Where can I find the REST API documentation and endpoints?
answer: Complete REST and GraphQL API specifications, authentication guides, and code examples are available at https://docs.example.com/api with an interactive Swagger test sandbox.

question: How do I generate and manage secret API keys?
answer: Go to Developer Console > API Keys. Click 'Create Secret Key', assign custom scopes (Read/Write), and securely save the token. Revoke old keys immediately if compromised.

question: What are the standard API rate limits and throttling rules?
answer: Standard tier allows 1,200 requests per minute with a burst allowance of 60 requests/second. Enterprise tiers offer custom rate limits and dedicated IP pools with guaranteed uptime SLAs.

question: How do I set up webhooks for real-time notifications?
answer: Go to Developer Console > Webhooks > Add Endpoint. Provide your HTTPS callback URL and select trigger events (e.g. `user.created`, `payment.succeeded`, `ticket.resolved`). Verify signatures using HMAC SHA-256.

question: What programming language SDK libraries do you support?
answer: We maintain official SDKs for Python (`pip install cloud-sdk`), TypeScript/Node.js (`npm i @cloud/sdk`), Go, and Java. Community-maintained packages for Ruby, PHP, and C# are also available.

question: How do I integrate Pinecone Vector Database with your API?
answer: Set `PINECONE_API_KEY` and `PINECONE_INDEX_NAME` in your environment settings. Our SDK connects to Pinecone automatically using cosine similarity metrics (384 dimensions for all-MiniLM-L6-v2).

question: How is customer data encrypted in transit and at rest?
answer: All network traffic is encrypted using TLS 1.3 protocol. Stored data and backups are encrypted at rest using AES-256 encryption with automated key rotation in SOC-2 Type II certified datacenters.

question: Is the service fully compliant with GDPR and CCPA regulations?
answer: Yes. We strictly adhere to GDPR, CCPA, and global privacy frameworks. Customers can exercise their Right to Access, Data Portability, and Right to Erasure directly in their privacy dashboard.

question: Do you sign Business Associate Agreements (BAA) for HIPAA compliance?
answer: Yes. For healthcare organizations on our Enterprise plan, we execute standard Business Associate Agreements (BAA) ensuring strict HIPAA-compliant audit logging and access controls.

question: How can I export a full backup of my workspace data?
answer: Go to Workspace Settings > Data Export. Select your format (JSON, CSV, or SQL dump). We will generate an encrypted archive and email a time-sensitive download link valid for 48 hours.

question: How do you handle security vulnerabilities and bug bounty reports?
answer: We maintain a responsible disclosure bug bounty program. Security researchers can submit vulnerability findings to security@example.com with reproducible proof-of-concept steps.

question: How can I track the live delivery status of my physical shipment?
answer: Once dispatched, an automated email containing your tracking code and carrier link (FedEx/DHL/UPS) is sent. You can also view live delivery milestones under 'My Orders' in your account.

question: What are your standard and expedited shipping delivery estimates?
answer: Domestic standard ground shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express overnight shipping arrives in 1-2 business days. International deliveries take 7-14 business days depending on customs.

question: Can I edit the destination address after placing an order?
answer: You can modify your shipping address within 60 minutes of placing an order from the 'My Orders' tab. After 60 minutes, the package is routed to warehouse fulfillment and cannot be changed.

question: Do you deliver internationally to all global countries?
answer: We deliver to over 130 countries worldwide. Applicable international shipping charges, import taxes, and customs duties are computed transparently at checkout.

question: What steps should I take if my shipment arrives damaged or missing items?
answer: Take clear photos of the damaged packaging within 48 hours of delivery and email support@example.com with your order number. We will dispatch an immediate free replacement.

question: How do I create and manage multiple workspaces?
answer: Click your workspace name in the top sidebar and select 'Create New Workspace'. You can switch between different company environments and manage billing separately for each.

question: What user roles and permission levels are supported?
answer: We support 4 granular permission roles: Owner (full administrative & billing control), Admin (manages members and integrations), Member (creates and edits content), and Guest (read-only access).

question: Can I invite external clients as free read-only guest collaborators?
answer: Yes! On Pro and Enterprise plans, you can invite unlimited read-only guest reviewers to view shared documents and dashboards without consuming paid team seats.

question: Does the system integrate with Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Jira?
answer: Yes! We offer official native integrations with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, GitHub, Notion, and Zapier. Enable them under Workspace Settings > Integrations.

question: Can multiple teammates edit the same document concurrently in real time?
answer: Yes. Our real-time collaborative editor uses Operational Transformation (OT) and CRDT protocols to display live presence cursors and synchronize edits instantaneously without conflicts.

question: How do file attachment uploads and storage limits work?
answer: Free plans include 5 GB of shared cloud storage. Pro plans provide 100 GB per seat, and Enterprise plans offer unlimited storage with maximum individual file upload size of 5 GB.

question: How do I contact human customer support?
answer: You can reach our human support team 24/7 via the live chat bubble at the bottom right corner of the app, or by emailing support@example.com. Enterprise customers have dedicated phone support.

question: What are your standard support operating hours and SLA response times?
answer: Live chat and email support operate 24/7/365. Standard tickets receive initial responses within 2 hours. Enterprise critical incidents are backed by a 15-minute SLA response guarantee.

question: Where can I monitor real-time server uptime and incident status?
answer: You can check real-time system health, scheduled maintenance windows, and historical uptime 24/7 on our public status page at https://status.example.com.

question: How do I enable Dark Mode theme in the web application?
answer: Click your avatar in the upper-right corner and select Theme > Dark Mode. You can also toggle 'Sync with System' to automatically match your operating system theme.

question: How do I submit product feature requests or feedback to the engineering team?
answer: We love customer input! You can submit feature requests, view upcoming roadmaps, and upvote community ideas on our public feedback board at https://feedback.example.com.

question: What keyboard shortcuts are available to speed up navigation?
answer: Press 'Cmd + K' (Mac) or 'Ctrl + K' (Windows) to trigger the Quick Command Bar. Press '?' at any time to open the full interactive shortcut overlay cheat sheet.
